band.basis: Sum of the three components: 60+4+0 = 64 (rounded 65) to 180+10+25 = 215, centre ~120. Price is for specialist removal AND disposal of non-friable (Class B) asbestos cement soffit sheeting by a WorkSafe-licensed removalist, on the stated assumption that the soffit is asbestos-containing and requires specialist removal; soffit area assumed ~50 m²; excludes replacement soffit, which is out of scope. Removal rate from AsbestosRNZ 2025 NZ cost guide (roof/cladding removal $60–$180/m²), corroborated at the low end by Safety 1st Removals (Class B cladding/fencing/roofing '$65 per sqm up'); clearance certificate from Safety 1st Removals ($200–$500 per job). QV CostBuilder was searched exhaustively and holds no asbestos row, so no QV rate contributes to the amounts. Not established by any source: the actual soffit area, whether the material is friable (Class A, $85–$500/m²) or non-friable, condition, containment class, and the disposal route — all of which can move the result by a factor of two or more. Confidence low. Get a firm m² rate from a licensed removalist (Chemcare, Asbestos Removal NZ, Safety 1st Removals/PropertyHelp) once the sheeting has been sampled and the area measured.

band.unit: m2 of soffit area (removal and disposal of asbestos-containing soffit material, excluding replacement soffit)
band.basis: QS working band, GST exclusive, sum of the two components above (70+5 low, 180+20 high), rounded. Main driver (licensed specialist removal) is priced from NZ removalist-published ranges because QV CostBuilder holds no asbestos/ACM rows at all; clearance is added as a separate required line. Prices the pinned assumption: non-friable bonded asbestos-cement eaves/soffit lining, reasonable condition, WorkSafe-licensed Class B contractor, containment included, single-storey/easy access, disposal included, no replacement soffit, no fascia, no testing, area assumed in the order of 100 m2 so fixed charges amortise sensibly. Small areas, two-storey/stepped eaves, occupied buildings or any friable finding move the price to and beyond the top of the band. Not a certified price - verify with three licensed removalist quotes and confirm licence class, area and disposal route before committing.

Sum of the three in-scope components only (the Class A air-monitoring uplift is excluded). Low = $85 removal + $5 access + $3 clearance; high = $300 removal + $30 access + $10 clearance. Prices a non-friable asbestos cement (Class B) soffit lining, GST exclusive, Auckland, assuming a ~100 m2 soffit area so the fixed per-job clearance charge can be amortised. Worked example at 100 m2: ~$9,500-$34,000, expected ~$18,000. Excludes replacement soffit (per brief), testing/survey (the brief already treats the soffit as ACM), and make-good to framing. Allowances carry only ~10% of the band, so the band is driven by the sourced removal rate - but that rate is a wide contractor-published band with no soffit-specific NZ publication and no QV coverage, hence low confidence. Regional variation is real: QV plant hire and tipping rows differ materially between Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch, and the published removal rates are not city-specific.
